name: TAPP Composition Module: Core
abstract: The shared Core block of the 2026-08-11 TAPP library, composed by 16 of the sixteen delivery tables. 30 owned fields over 35 schema paths, split into the procedure and analysis halves a TAPP schema and a technique detail compose respectively. A profile over existing tappDefinition/adaProduct properties, not a new vocabulary. Generated from the module CSV and its schema-path sidecar.
